product_metadata.title: GoWISE USA GWA0011 Perforated Parchment Non-Stick Liners for Air Fryer Toaster Ovens, Dehydrators, Steaming, Dumplings-100 Pcs, 11.5 x 10 inches, White
features: Designed to be greaseproof, non-absorbent, and non-stick, so it doesn't matter what you are making.
This parchment paper is heat resistant up to 450 degreesºF. Can be used when cooking anything in your Air Fryer.
Fits Air fryer ovens, toaster ovens, and dehydrators from size 17-quart and up or with trays that measure 11 x 10 inches and up or cut to fit smaller sized ovens such as 12.7 Quart Air Fryer Ovens
Parchment paper that is perforated to allow air flow when used in Air Fryer and it makes clean up a breeze.
description: This Parchment Paper pack comes with 100 Pieces. It is perforated to assist with air flow within the Air Fryer Ovens. With its double-sided silicone coating, non-stick capacity and greaseproof capabilities, it makes clean up a breeze. Clean-up even faster when using parchment paper! It’s heat resistant up to 450 degrees F, so don’t worry about overheating.
